giver: Sister Wren (Reece's cleric), the spirits, and characters who come to you
feel: A mystery that grows into a reckoning: the silent forest, the drained wardens, the eight sleepers, and the fire at the end.

quests.title: The Silent Wood
quests.summary: Go to the forest edge after dusk and wait out one night: no fairies dance, the butterflies are gone, and something has scored the bark of the oldest tree.

quests.title: A Shrine for the Quiet
quests.summary: Sister Wren asks for a small wayside shrine: build it from mossy stone and candles, and offer wildflowers from three biomes.

quests.title: Somewhere to Come Back To
quests.summary: Build your first home near Reece with a bed, a chest, a table and chairs from Handcrafted or Another Furniture.

quests.title: The Fallen Adventurer
quests.summary: Find the remains of an adventurer in the wild; their rusted gear holds a journal page about 'the wardens growing weak'.
quests.reward: The journal page, a stone sword

quests.title: What the Dark Keeps
quests.summary: The journal points to an old dungeon: clear a YUNG's dungeon of its spawners and find the second journal page in its loot.
quests.reward: Iron ingots, a Lootr chest's treasure

quests.title: Word to the Neighbours
quests.summary: Sister Wren writes to the cleric of the next village with Friends of the Forest Mail; carry the reply back yourself when the mail is too slow.

quests.title: The First Wardens
quests.summary: Both journal pages together tell of guardians, the wardens, who hold the old places shut. Sister Wren fears they are being drained, and names the first of them.
quests.reward: Iron armour piece, the Act I page in the Field Guide

quests.title: Iron and Edge
quests.summary: Arm yourself for what's ahead: craft a Spartan Weaponry weapon of your choice, a Spartan shield and full iron armour.

quests.title: Sand and Vine
quests.summary: Search a YUNG's desert or jungle temple: solve its traps and levers to reach the inner chamber, where a mural shows a hooded iron giant.

quests.title: The Echo in the Shaft
quests.summary: Miners in a YUNG's mineshaft heard metal footsteps below: explore it, gather 16 iron ore, and find the scrape marks leading down.

quests.title: The Iron Door
quests.summary: Follow the scrape marks to a Wrought Chamber and look at its sealed door without stepping in. The armour inside is breathing.

quests.title: Strike From Behind
quests.summary: The Village watch's captain sets up a MmmMmmMmmMmm target dummy: land ten hits from behind within a minute while dodging her swings, the way you'll fight the Wroughtnaut.

quests.title: The Ferrous Wroughtnaut
quests.summary: Wake the Ferrous Wroughtnaut (40 health, hits for 30) and beat it by dodging its axe and striking its exposed back.
quests.reward: Golden apples, a Wrought Helm display stand

quests.title: Rust on the Seal
quests.summary: Bring the Wroughtnaut's broken seal-plate to Sister Wren: the warden wasn't evil, it was starving, and something had fed on it.

quests.title: A Priest on the Road
quests.summary: A travelling priest of the Arcane order says the drain smells of old magic and points you to a Pyromancer Tower. Branch: the magic questline continues from here.

quests.title: Banners on the Hill
quests.summary: Pillagers have raised an outpost near the trade road: clear it, take down its captain and burn the banner.

quests.title: Frost on the Wind
quests.summary: A frightened trader rides into Reece: an Iceologer froze his caravan in the snowy taiga. Track it down and end it before it reaches the village.

quests.title: Four of Him
quests.summary: An Illusioner haunts the woods near a village; find the real one among its copies and defeat it.
quests.reward: A bow of the trickster (Power II)

quests.title: The Long Night
quests.summary: Captain Hale hires Guard Villagers to stand with you; carry the Bad Omen into Reece and hold the village through a full raid without losing a guard.

quests.title: Masks in the Grass
quests.summary: Travel to the savanna and find the Umvuthana Grove; watch the Umvuthana from cover without being spotted and count their masks.

quests.title: Umvuthi, the Sunbird
quests.summary: Face Umvuthi (150 health) and its followers in the heart of the grove; break the circle of masks before the sun spell lands.

quests.title: A Door in the Flowers
quests.summary: With two wardens freed, Sister Wren remembers the spirits' own realm: dig a pool, ring it with flowers and drop a diamond in to open the Twilight Forest portal.
quests.reward: Diamond, flowers, the Act II page

quests.title: Where the Spirits Went
quests.summary: Step through into the Twilight Forest and find its quest grove: the spirits are here, hiding, and they speak of the drain as a hunger rising from below.

quests.title: The Twilight Calls (Part 1)
quests.summary: The spirits ask you to lift the first curses: defeat the Naga in its courtyard and the Lich in its tower. Branch: the Twilight Forest questline holds the rest of this realm.
quests.reward: Naga scales, a Twilight trophy shelf

quests.title: Ice Where None Should Be
quests.summary: Reece's shepherd lost a flock to a white beast in the snowy hills; the spirits name it Frostmaw, a warden of winter woken too early.

quests.title: Tracks in the Snow
quests.summary: Follow broken ice and frozen carcasses across a snowy biome to where Frostmaw sleeps, and leave a trap of lit campfires at its den.

quests.title: Frostmaw
quests.summary: Wake and defeat Frostmaw (250 health) without letting its ice breath freeze you to the ground.

quests.title: The Cold Heart
quests.summary: Carry the Ice Crystal Frostmaw left behind to Sister Wren; it's flecked with dark veins, proof the drain comes from deep underground.

quests.title: A Map of the Underworld
quests.summary: Find a cave tablet or trade a cartographer for an Alex's Caves Cave Map and follow it to your first cave biome. Branch: the Underworld questline takes over below.

quests.title: Roots of the Drain
quests.summary: In the Magnetic Caves and the Primordial Caves, gather a scarlet neodymium ingot and amber; both hum with the same dark pulse as the crystal.

quests.title: Breath of the Deep
quests.summary: Brew potions of water breathing and night vision and enchant a helmet with Respiration at an Easy Magic table for the ocean monument.

quests.title: The Elder of the Sea
quests.summary: Dive into a YUNG's Better Ocean Monument and defeat one of its Elder Guardians, the ocean's own warden, half drained already.

quests.title: The Sealed Pyramid
quests.summary: Scout a Cataclysm Cursed Pyramid in the desert: clear its outer halls of Koboletons and defeat a Kobolediator for Ancient Metal.

quests.title: The Frosted Prison
quests.summary: Scout a Frosted Prison in the snowy plains and defeat an Aptrgangr guarding its gate for Black Steel. The inner door is sealed; something vast sleeps behind it.

quests.title: Doors That Will Not Open
quests.summary: Study the Door of Seal in both strongholds and copy its runes for the Arcane order's librarian: eight seals, eight sleepers, and none can be broken yet.

quests.title: Steel From the Sleepers
quests.summary: Forge a Spartan Weaponry: Cataclysm weapon from the Ancient Metal or Black Steel you took from the guardians.

quests.title: The Peak Above the Clouds
quests.summary: The last Overworld warden waits at a mountaintop Monastery: climb the peak with ParCool moves and a grappling hook before the storm closes in.

quests.title: The Sculptor
quests.summary: Climb the Sculptor's pillar trial while it reshapes the stone beneath you, then defeat it (140 health).

quests.title: The Red Glow
quests.summary: From the peak you see a red scar on the horizon: a ruined portal. Repair or build a Nether portal and step into the Nether for the first time.
quests.reward: Fire resistance potions, the Act III page

quests.title: The Burning Realm
quests.summary: In the Nether, a lost Reece courier hides in a ruin; she saw the drain's threads running toward the fortresses. Branch: the Nether questline starts here.

quests.title: Blaze and Bone
quests.summary: Raid a YUNG's Better Nether Fortress for 12 blaze rods and nether wart.

quests.title: Eyes That See
quests.summary: Craft Eyes of Ender, then turn one into a Mowzie's Cataclysm eye (Wrought, Sun, Frostmaw or Tongbi): they find wardens' homes, a second way to every Mowzie structure.

quests.title: The Citadel of Flame
quests.summary: Find the Friends & Foes Nether citadel and slip past its blazes to see the Wildfire on its throne.

quests.title: The Wildfire
quests.summary: Defeat the Wildfire (120 health) by breaking its shields and dodging its fire waves.

quests.title: Debris From Below
quests.summary: Mine 8 ancient debris deep in the Nether; Ultimine and beds help, but watch your footing.

quests.title: The Black Smith
quests.summary: Loot a netherite upgrade template from a bastion and upgrade your first netherite piece.

quests.title: The Twilight Calls (Part 2)
quests.summary: The spirits' second curse: defeat the Hydra in its fiery lair and forge a Fiery weapon from its blood with Spartan Weaponry: Twilight Forest. Branch: the Twilight questline continues.

quests.title: The Dead King's Crypt
quests.summary: Optional branch: the Arcane order traces the drain to Iron's Catacombs and the Dead King (500 health). Reaching the catacombs opens the magic questline's chain, which holds the fight.

quests.title: Three Black Skulls
quests.summary: Hunt wither skeletons in fortresses until you hold three wither skeleton skulls; a fourth, cursed one only drops while this quest is open.

quests.title: The Wither
quests.summary: Summon the Wither far from Reece, in a pit you dig deep underground, and destroy it (300 health). The world's wardens are being turned; this one was made to be.

quests.title: A Light for Reece
quests.summary: Build a beacon on a pyramid in Reece's square so the village has a light the drain can't reach.

quests.title: Something Below the Chasm
quests.summary: Optional branch: a diver's logbook speaks of something huge circling a ruined submarine in the Abyssal Chasm. Finding the trench opens the Alex's Caves questline's chain, which holds the Hullbreaker fight.

quests.title: Something Green Hatches
quests.summary: Optional: in the Toxic Caves, find a Tremorzilla egg and raise it, or fight a wild one (500 health).

quests.title: Where the Eyes Fall
quests.summary: Throw Eyes of Ender across the land until they dive, then dig down into a YUNG's Better Stronghold.
quests.reward: Eyes of Ender, the Act IV page

quests.title: The Stronghold Library
quests.summary: In the stronghold's library, a book left by the Field Guide's author warns that the Void's dragon is the last seal keeping the eight sleepers down.

quests.title: The Twilight Calls (Part 3)
quests.summary: The spirits' last curse: climb to the Aurora Palace and free the Snow Queen's frozen court. Branch: the Twilight questline ends there.

quests.title: Twelve Empty Eyes
quests.summary: Find the portal room and fill every frame. Before you jump, a spirit voice begs you to come back.

quests.title: Towers of Light
quests.summary: On YUNG's rebuilt End island, destroy every End crystal on its towers within ten minutes of arriving.

quests.title: The Ender Dragon
quests.summary: Defeat the Ender Dragon (200 health). Branch: the End questline opens with the gateway.

quests.title: Wings at the Edge
quests.summary: Through the gateway, raid an End city for an elytra and 8 shulker shells.

quests.title: Ships Beyond the Void
quests.summary: Find one of Moog's End mega-ships drifting over Nullscape's islands and read its captain's log about a ruined citadel.

quests.title: The Void Worm
quests.summary: Optional: feed a Mysterious Worm to the void in the End and defeat the Void Worm that rises.

quests.title: The Deep Dark Listener
quests.summary: Optional: sneak through an ancient city and take its echo shards; fight the Warden (500 health) only if you must.

quests.title: The Eight Wake
quests.summary: Back in Reece the ground shakes: the dragon was the Void's guard, and with it gone the eight sealed strongholds wake. A spirit messenger appears to tell you the drain's source burns in the Nether.
quests.reward: Netherite scrap, the Act V page

quests.title: The Reckoning
quests.summary: Sister Wren and the guild leaders gather in Reece: break the eight in turn, weakest first. Craft the Infernal Forge to work the sleepers' metals.

quests.title: An Eye of Netherite
quests.summary: Craft a Monstrous Eye from netherite scrap and follow it through the Nether to the Soul Black Smith.

quests.title: The Netherite Monstrosity
quests.summary: Defeat the Netherite Monstrosity (600 health, damage-capped) in the forge where it was built.

quests.title: An Eye of the Void
quests.summary: Craft a Void Eye from shulker shells and follow it across the End highlands to the Ruined Citadel.

quests.title: Golems of the Citadel
quests.summary: Clear the Ruined Citadel's Ender Golems and Endermapteras without falling into the void traps.

quests.title: The Ender Guardian
quests.summary: Defeat the Ender Guardian (333 health) and claim the Gauntlet of Guard.

quests.title: An Eye of Gears
quests.summary: Craft a Mech Eye and follow it down to the Ancient Factory buried deep underground.

quests.title: Cold Furnaces
quests.summary: The factory's furnaces are dead: bring lava power cells to restart its machines and reach the Harbinger's chamber before its Prowlers notice.

quests.title: The Harbinger
quests.summary: Defeat the Harbinger (390 health), a machine built in the Wither's image, mirroring your fight in Act III.

quests.title: An Eye of Storms
quests.summary: Craft a Storm Eye with prismarine and diamonds, then sail a Small Ships vessel across the warm ocean to the Acropolis.

quests.title: Claws of the Acropolis
quests.summary: Cut through the Acropolis's Hippocamtus and Cindaria and defeat a Clawdian (225 health) guarding the storm altar.

quests.title: Scylla
quests.summary: Defeat Scylla (390 health) in the eye of her storm.

quests.title: Back to the Pyramid
quests.summary: Craft a Desert Eye and return to the Cursed Pyramid you scouted in Act II; its seal now answers.

quests.title: The Serpent Guard
quests.summary: Defeat the Wadjets and Kobolediators of the inner pyramid and arm yourself with a Spartan Weaponry: Cataclysm Ancient Metal weapon.

quests.title: The Ancient Remnant
quests.summary: Defeat the Ancient Remnant (450 health) beneath the pyramid, then fuse its Sandstorm in a Bottle with the Gauntlet of Guard into the Gauntlet of Maelstrom.

quests.title: The Abyssal Sacrifice
quests.summary: Gather a Heart of the Sea, nautilus shells and mineral blocks for the Abyssal Sacrifice, and craft an Abyss Eye to find the Sunken City.

quests.title: The Drowned Streets
quests.summary: Dive into the Sunken City in the deep ocean, clear its Deeplings and defeat a Coral Golem.

quests.title: The Leviathan
quests.summary: Place the Abyssal Sacrifice on the Altar of the Abyss and defeat the Leviathan (400 health) in its own water.

quests.title: A Warning in Ice
quests.summary: An old Village watch veteran warns of Maledictus's lifting slam, the move that ends most who face it. Craft a Cursed Eye and stock up on totems.

quests.title: The Prison Wakes
quests.summary: Return to the Frosted Prison, now unsealed, and fight through Draugr and Aptrgangr to its lowest cell block.

quests.title: Maledictus
quests.summary: Defeat Maledictus (420 health) and keep moving when it rises to slam; craft Cursium armour from what it leaves.

quests.title: The Volcano Wakes
quests.summary: Optional side branch: tremors from a Primordial Caves volcano point to something ancient stirring. Reaching the volcano opens the Alex's Caves questline's finale, which holds the Luxtructosaurus fight.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a Primordial Caves map

quests.title: An Eye of Flame
quests.summary: Craft the Flame Eye and follow it into the nether wastes to the Burning Arena: the source of the drain, glowing with every warden's stolen strength.

quests.title: All of Reece Behind You
quests.summary: Every organisation sends something for the last fight: food from the Tavern keepers, potions from the Herbalists, a blessed shield from the Village watch. Collect them all in Reece.
quests.reward: A feast, a named shield, healing potions

quests.title: The Ash Guard
quests.summary: Clear the Ignited Revenants and Berserkers that guard the Burning Arena's approach.

quests.title: Ignis
quests.summary: Face Ignis (450 health), the fire that fed on the world's wardens, and put it out.

quests.title: The Forest Sings
quests.summary: Walk back into the forest at dusk: the fairies and fireflies have returned, and Sister Wren holds a festival in Reece in your honour.
quests.reward: A unique named sword, the end of the story
